newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen details Lam Research.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen details Lam Research.

text.p: Cowen & Co said it upgraded Lam Research Corp to buy from neutral based on a recent, positive investor meeting and a improving margin outlook over the next six to eight quarters.

-- said Lam Research told analysts it projects its end markets to grow at 20 percent compound annual growth rate through the year 2001, with calendar year 1998 showing a return to true revenue and earnings acceleration.

-- said Lam Research is targeting gross margins at 47-49 percent in six to eight quarters. Said believes this could result in calendar year 1998 estimates in the $3.00 to $3.50 a share range, compare to Cowen's current estimate of $2.30 a share. Cowen said it was reviewing its earnings model.
-- Lam Research gained 6 to 55-5/8 in afternoon trading.
